issues.description: local_rank defaults to None and crashes torch.cuda.set_device before distributed init
issues.detail: In train.py main(), `torch.cuda.set_device(args.local_rank)` is called with default `None`. When the script is launched outside a launcher that injects --local_rank (e.g., torchrun uses LOCAL_RANK env var, not the deprecated CLI flag), this raises TypeError before deepspeed.init_distributed() runs. Read LOCAL_RANK from env as fallback.

issues.description: trainer_args key mismatch: docstring says max_steps/val_interval but code reads max_step and never uses val_interval
issues.detail: The docstring lists `max_steps`, `val_interval`, `save_interval`. Code reads `trainer_args["max_step"]` (singular) and never references `val_interval`. Validation is instead driven by `save_interval` in `run()`. This will KeyError on configs following the documented schema, and validation cadence is silently coupled to save cadence.

issues.description: Checkpoint resume directory listing always triggers because mkdir created it
issues.detail: `(self.output_dir / "checkpoints").mkdir(exist_ok=True, parents=True)` runs in __init__, so the Step-2 `exists()` check is always true and the elif glob runs even when the user explicitly passed resume_path that does not exist. Combined with `resume_path and resume_path.exists()`, a stale path silently falls through to the latest local checkpoint, which can mask user error.

issues.description: Training loop can exceed max_step because inner train() runs save_interval batches unconditionally
issues.detail: `run()` loops while `global_step < max_step` and calls `train()` which iterates `save_interval` batches. There is no inner check against `max_step`, so the final epoch overshoots by up to `save_interval-1` steps, and a checkpoint named `step_<overshoot>` is written. Add a per-batch break when `self.global_step >= self.max_step`.

issues.description: Non-rank-0 ranks call wandb.log every step despite mode='disabled', and rank-0 logs raw summed grad_norm/lr without sync
issues.detail: `wandb.log` is called inside train/valid on every rank. With `mode="disabled"` this is a no-op but still adds overhead and clutter; more importantly the metric pipeline assumes all ranks compute stats identically. Consider gating `wandb.log` and the stats float() conversions to rank 0 after all_reduce, and document that get_global_grad_norm/get_lr are already-synced engine values.

issues.description: Inconsistent CLI flag naming mixes hyphens and underscores
issues.detail: Argparse defines `--train-config`, `--output-dir`, etc. with hyphens but `--local_rank` and `--resume_path` with underscores. argparse converts hyphens to underscores for the attribute name, but this inconsistency is confusing for users writing launch scripts and breaks shell completion conventions. Pick one style (likely hyphens) for all user-facing flags.

review.summary: The PR introduces a DeepSpeed-based trainer and launcher for SpeechLM. The most pressing issues are a None-default `--local_rank` that will crash before distributed init under modern torchrun, and a config-key mismatch between the documented `max_steps`/`val_interval` and the actually-read `max_step` (with no `val_interval` ever consulted). Secondary concerns include overshooting `max_step` because the inner train loop is bounded by `save_interval` rather than the remaining step budget, a checkpoint-resume fallback that always activates due to mkdir, and inconsistent CLI flag naming. Validation cadence appears unintentionally tied to save cadence.
